subQuests.subQuestName: Go to The Court of the Millennial Pearl Seahorse

746840101.text: Thanks for your hard work over the last few days. We did deviate from our original goal, sure, but I for one have gained much from these experiences.

746840104.text: Gained much... Don't you mean you learned a lot of lessons?

746840105.text: That too, yes. Cultivating friendships is a long-term process, and you need to spend more time after making your pick, not like what we did this time...

746840106.text: Just like Natlan was once the land of ancient dragons, and is now a land where humans and Saurians put mutual trust in one another, becoming comrades who live side by side... I wonder how long that must've taken.

746840107.text: *sigh* I suppose I was too overeager. I thought we could gain their respect by beating them, which is why I picked such blunt methods.

746840108.text: If we had taken our time from the start... Perhaps feeding them every day and trying to get closer to them might have boosted our chances!

746840109.text: That sounds reasonable enough until you remember that the targets you picked aren't your everyday dogs or cats.

746840110.text: True, true. They're more like the Saurians of Natlan — that is why I picked them, after all.

746840111.text: I imagine that my friends there would understand what an extraordinary thing I've done when I relate these experiences to them.

746840112.text: Paimon still doesn't see the similarities — the Primo Geovishap aside — but you do you.

746840113.text: Hmm? The others were quite similar too. The colors, for example...

746840114.text: If that's where you're headed, then Slimes would also be similar enough, no?

746840115.text: I see where you're coming from. They are both elemental creatures... Perhaps Slimes do have the potential to become Saurians...

746840116.text: Does that mean that I should try making friends with Slimes first?
